stories.title: Plague panic after a death at a Russian plague lab
stories.summary: Darya Shipilova, a 28-year-old lab technician at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute in Siberia, died of severe pneumonia, Russian outlets reported she had broken a test tube of live plague bacteria, and US feeds filled with claims that plague had escaped a lab. Visegrád 24's post that five hospitals had been closed for quarantine got 43K likes, Raw Alerts' "Infectious 'plague' escapes Siberian lab" got 65K, and "The Pneumonic Plague that just escaped a lab in Russia is about 100x deadlier than COVID" got 58K. Russian health officials denied any lab accident and called the death "pneumonia of unknown etiology"; all of her roughly 200 contacts later tested negative.
